messages.content: Audit a proposed relationship between a documentary quote and a claim. Option establishes_proposed_relation applies only if the highlighted quote establishes the proposed relation for the exact named party, action, and scope. Use the surrounding source only to resolve who and what the quote refers to. Check wording strength: a limit on all does not decide whether some, and support for adoption or discussion does not alone establish a vote, commitment, or a separate claim. A contradiction requires that the quoted position and the claim cannot both be true. Use insufficient for silence, incomplete coverage, or any remaining ambiguity. Use establishes_opposite_relation only when the quote establishes the other relation. Return only the option letter.
